$comment: Ratchet baseline for `is:inline` / `define:vars` script in .astro files — the code that opts out of bundling, typing and imports at once. A plain `<script>` in an .astro file is NOT counted: it is a bundled TypeScript module that `astro check` covers and that can import, so it is not the problem this guard exists for. The `migrating` set may only SHRINK: a file that grows fails, and so does one that shrinks (retighten the number rather than leave slack for the next one to hide in) — same idiom as typecheck-baseline.json and page-fork-baseline.json. Enforced by tests/inline-script-ratchet.test.ts; measured by scripts/lib/inline-script-inventory.mjs, which also prints a report when run directly.
bridgeNote: A file with 25 or fewer unbundled lines needs no entry here. That is deliberate slack, and it is safe: every current one is a payload bridge (a define:vars block whose whole job is handing a JSON string to the bundled module next to it) or a two-line guard. Nothing that small can hide an application. Cross the threshold and you must add an entry, which is the point — it forces the choice between `sanctioned` and `migrating` at the moment the code is written.

src/components/TransitionNoiseGuard.astr.why: Rescues a ClientRouter soft navigation whose DOM swap failed. It has to be installed around the router's own transition handling, before any module of ours could run.

src/components/theleague/RosterLoader.as.why: Branded loader shown during the view-transition wait on the way TO /rosters. Its own docblock states the reason: it must run pre-hydration, on the page you navigate FROM, and must not be touched by the bundler.

src/components/ThemeScript.astro.why: Pre-paint theme resolver, rendered before any stylesheet in every layout. A bundled module is deferred, so making this one would ship a flash of the wrong theme on every cold load.

src/layouts/TheLeagueLayout.astro.why: Three pre-hydration blocks: service-worker registration, the dev-only SW unregister, and the navigation progress bar. Each must run before hydration and outside module scheduling. The PWA auth gate that used to live here is NOT in this count — it became a bundled script when it moved onto the shared session query.

src/pages/theleague/rosters.astro.why: `is:inline data-astro-rerun` — installs and tears down a window-level banner across ClientRouter navigations. The router skips an inline script it has already run, so `data-astro-rerun` is the mechanism, and it only exists for inline scripts. Note this is 57 of that file's 7,254 script lines; the other 7,197 are a bundled module and belong to the type baseline, not here.

notes.whyThisExists: Interactivity in this app is written two ways: React islands (typed, testable, in Storybook) and hand-rolled DOM script. The bundled half of the script is fine — it is TypeScript under the type baseline. This guard is aimed at the ~4.4k lines that are neither: no types, no imports, no type-checking, and no way to share a helper with the island rendering beside them.
notes.howToShrink: Move the block into a React island when a component owns the state, or into a bundled `<script>` module when the DOM is server-rendered and the script is progressive enhancement — then lower the numbers here. src/components/shared/assets/assets-page-behaviors.ts is the worked example of the second path (101 lines, 2026-09-01); the TradeBuilder/useSession migration is the worked example of the first. See docs/claude/rules/client-data.md § Retiring an inline script.
notes.biggestFirst: players.astro (both leagues) was de-inlined 2026-09-01 into src/scripts/players/. The pages stay FORKED — they had diverged 56% (TheLeague carries contracts, salary and the auction board; the AFL carries conferences and ADP), so a single page component would have been worse than two. The ~21 genuinely shared functions are the real unification target, and they are now in modules where that is possible. Next biggest inline blocks: mock-draft/index.astro (492) and projected-free-agents.astro (385).
